title: Accordion-Fold Greeting Card
content: When I did this painting of Dinotopians riding through a field of flowers in 1996, I had to address two unique design constraints. On the one hand, I wanted to create a frieze-like composition for a horizontal poster,using the kids who won a national poster contest as models.I also designed the image to work as an accordion-fold greeting card for Portal Publishing's "Streamers" line.  The card was printed the same on both sides and then die cut around the silhouettes.When the card was all folded up, the silhouettes overlapped in such a way that faces could peek out in a surprising way.Previous post about the kids who modeled for the painting.
